onChange.script:
if self.session.custom.what["{}Modifier".format(self.view.params.id)] != currentValue.value:
            self.session.custom.what["{}Modifier".format(self.view.params.id)] = currentValue.value
            system.perspective.sendMessage("refresh", "{}Modifier".format(self.view.params.id), "session")
            # system.perspective.print("{}Check updated".format(self.view.params.id))

if self.session.custom.what["{}Score".format(self.view.params.id)] != currentValue.value:
        self.session.custom.what["{}Score".format(self.view.params.id)] = currentValue.value
        system.perspective.sendMessage("refresh", "{}Score".format(self.view.params.id), "session")
        # system.perspective.print("{}Check updated".format(self.view.params.id))
